title: Design exercise: SAA-3.5-S03
scenario: Fairlight Packaging is consolidating its data onto AWS and has three separate flows to design. A plant NAS holds 8 TB of production records that change each week, and the full set must be refreshed in AWS over the plant's 1 Gbps internet link inside a 48-hour weekend window, arriving with file permissions and proven intact. Three branch offices of 40 staff each use Windows and Linux applications that open files from a shared network folder; the files must also exist as objects for the analytics team, and staff expect recently used files to open at local-network speed from a small on-site disk. Finally, 25,000 packing-line sensors emit readings that must appear in the analytics bucket within 2 minutes of being taken, with no processing logic and no need to re-read old readings.
constraints: Do not claim live AWS experience
No appliance may be shipped or collected for any flow; all movement is over networks
All three flows end in the analytics team's single bucket
Each branch office can spare only one small virtual machine host

rubric.label: The weekly 8 TB refresh completes inside the 48-hour window on the 1 Gbps link (the required rate worked out and stated), arrives with its file permissions, and is verified as intact
Branch staff keep opening recently used files at local speed while every file also exists in the analytics bucket, and sensor readings land there within 2 minutes using no custom processing code

constraint_reason: Mapped as design_exercise to complete skill coverage when no dedicated live lab step exists
